note: The 26 new applications that replace the Tableau suite. The five flagships (DL-01 to DL-05) stay frozen. Each app sits in one of the four Pioneer verticals.

apps.title: Massachusetts K-12
apps.q: Enrollment, MCAS, attendance, dropouts, and school finances for Massachusetts districts.
apps.heritage: Formerly Education Fast Facts, Enrollment by Grade, MCAS NEXTGEN, School Attendance, Dropouts & Graduates, MA Demographics, and School Finances
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks states on NCES Digest current expenditures per pupil (2020-21, unadjusted) and reports Massachusetts Fall 2023 public K-12 enrollment. District MCAS, attendance, dropouts, and DESE finance files are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover national NAEP, higher education, charter-only national files, or advice about a school choice. MCAS and district files are pending.

sources.name: NCES Digest tables 236.65 (per-pupil) and 203.20 (enrollment)

apps.title: National K-12
apps.q: NAEP reading and math, enrollment, finance, completion, and discipline across the 50 states.
apps.heritage: Formerly Reading/Math Achievement, K-12 Enrollment, K-12 School Finance, High School Completion, and Discipline & Security
apps.scope: This ledger ranks states on NCES Digest public K-12 enrollment for Fall 2023, and also reports the 2021-22 adjusted cohort graduation rate and the 2020-21 out-of-school suspension share. Per-pupil finance sits on Massachusetts K-12. NAEP state scores are listed as a later view.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover Massachusetts-only DESE files (those sit on Massachusetts K-12) or higher education. NAEP state scores are pending.

sources.name: NCES NAEP state results
NCES Digest table 203.20, public K-12 enrollment
NCES Digest table 219.46, 4-year adjusted cohort graduation rate
NCES Digest table 233.40, out-of-school suspension share

apps.title: Higher Education
apps.q: College admissions tests, enrollment, faculty, and student outcomes.
apps.heritage: Formerly Higher Education College Admissions, Enrollment, Faculty and Staff, and Student Data
apps.scope: This ledger ranks states on NCES Digest fall enrollment in degree-granting postsecondary institutions for 2022, and also reports 2023 SAT mean scores by state and the national Fall 2023 faculty count. IPEDS outcomes remain a later view.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover K-12, rankings of individual colleges as advice, or predictions of admission. State-level faculty counts and IPEDS outcomes are pending.

sources.name: NCES Digest table 304.10, fall postsecondary enrollment
NCES Digest table 226.40, SAT mean scores by state
NCES Digest table 315.10, faculty in degree-granting institutions (national)

apps.title: Charters and School Staff
apps.q: Charter school counts and education staff by state and district.
apps.heritage: Formerly School Districts Charter Schools and Education Staff
apps.scope: This ledger ranks states on NCES Digest public charter fall enrollment for 2022-23, and also reports public-school teacher full-time-equivalent counts for Fall 2022.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover a directory of every U.S. district or advice about opening a charter.

sources.name: NCES Digest table 216.90, charter schools and enrollment
NCES Digest table 208.30, public-school teachers (FTE)

apps.title: Massachusetts Hospitals
apps.q: Hospital relative prices and the Massachusetts hospital tracker.
apps.heritage: Formerly Hospital Tracker and Relative Price Tracker
apps.scope: This first ledger lists Massachusetts hospitals from CMS Hospital General Information, including overall star ratings, type, and ownership. CHIA relative prices remain a later view.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover 340B, Medicaid, other states, or advice about where to seek care. CHIA relative prices are pending.

sources.name: Massachusetts CHIA hospital relative prices and hospital profiles
CMS Hospital General Information, Massachusetts facilities

apps.title: 340B
apps.q: 340B program growth, hospital charity care, and state legislative mapping.
apps.heritage: Formerly 340B Program Growth, Hospital Charity Care, and Legislative Mapping
apps.scope: Covers 340B covered-entity growth, hospital charity-care shares, and a map of state 340B legislation.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover advice to a hospital or manufacturer, or predictions of federal rulemaking.

sources.name: HRSA Office of Pharmacy Affairs 340B covered-entity data
CMS Hospital Cost Report charity-care worksheets

apps.title: Medicaid and State Health Spending
apps.q: State Medicaid spending, broader state health expenses, and Medicaid fraud recoveries.
apps.heritage: Formerly State Medicaid Expenses, State Health Expenses, and Medicaid Fraud
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks states on CMS Medicaid Financial Management Report FY 2024 Medical Assistance Program total-computable net expenditures. Broader state health spending and fraud recoveries are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover individual eligibility, Massachusetts hospital prices, or 340B. NASBO health-chapter and fraud files are pending.

sources.name: CMS Medicaid Financial Management Report FY 2024 net expenditures
NASBO State Expenditure Report, health chapter

apps.title: Business Formation
apps.q: New business applications and projected formations, state by state, from Census BFS.
apps.heritage: Formerly Business Births and Deaths and Business Dynamics
apps.scope: Covers Census Business Formation Statistics: seasonally adjusted business applications and projected formations within four quarters, for the United States and each state.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover establishment births and deaths from the Business Employment Dynamics file, industry clusters, or advice about starting a firm.

sources.name: Census Bureau Business Formation Statistics monthly time series

apps.title: Labor Market
apps.q: Unemployment, employment, and labor force by state from BLS LAUS.
apps.heritage: Formerly Labor Market, Monthly Employment, Employment and Wages, Total Labor Force, Weekly Wages, Labor Demographics, and Unemployment Insurance
apps.scope: Covers BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics: seasonally adjusted unemployment rate, employment, and labor force for every state and D.C. Also reports QCEW average weekly wages for 2025 Q4. UI claims and CPS demographics remain later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover occupational wages, UI claims, or advice about a job search. UI claims and CPS demographics are pending on this page.

sources.name: BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics, statewide seasonally adjusted
BLS QCEW average weekly wage, all industries, statewide

apps.title: GDP and Economic Profiles
apps.q: State GDP, personal income, and the Massachusetts and U.S. economic profiles.
apps.heritage: Formerly Gross Domestic Product, GDP by NAICS, Personal Income, and MA/US Economic Profile
apps.scope: This ledger ranks states on BEA real GDP for 2025 (chained 2017 dollars, all industry), and also reports 2025 personal income and per capita personal income. NAICS industry detail remains a later view.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover forecasts, municipal GDP, or advice about relocation. NAICS industry detail is pending.

sources.name: BEA SAGDP1 real GDP by state, 1997-2025
BEA SAINC4 personal income and per capita personal income by state

apps.title: Housing Market
apps.q: Building permits by state, the production side of the housing file.
apps.heritage: Formerly Housing Production and Housing Prices
apps.scope: Covers Census Building Permits Survey: year-to-date authorized units by state. Also reports the FHFA all-transactions house-price index annual change by state. Case-Shiller city indexes remain a later view.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover Florida insurance (that is DL-02), individual listings, or advice about buying a house. Case-Shiller city indexes are pending on this page.

sources.name: Census Bureau Building Permits Survey, state year-to-date files
FHFA all-transactions house-price index, annual state file

apps.title: Population and Migration
apps.q: State population, domestic migration, and the rural-urban continuum.
apps.heritage: Formerly Population Change, Domestic Migration, US Demographics, and Rural to Urban
apps.scope: Covers Census vintage state population estimates, domestic and international migration, births, and deaths. The rural-urban continuum is listed as a later view.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover IRS taxpayer migration (that is Taxpayer Migration) or municipal populations (that is Municipal Atlas). USDA rural-urban codes are pending on this page.

sources.name: Census Bureau vintage 2025 state population estimates

apps.title: Patents and Innovation
apps.q: Utility patents by state and sector.
apps.heritage: Formerly Patents by State and Sector
apps.scope: Covers USPTO utility patents granted by inventor state and technology class.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover trademarks, university rankings, or advice about filing a patent.

sources.name: USPTO PatentView / PatentsView state and class counts

apps.title: Cost of Living
apps.q: Regional price parities, state fiscal dependency, tariffs, and defense impact.
apps.heritage: Formerly Cost of Living, State Dependency, Tariff Impacts, and Defense Impact
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks states on BEA all-items regional price parities for 2024 (United States = 100). State-dependency, tariff, and defense measures are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover a household budget calculator or advice about moving. Tariff and defense files are pending.

sources.name: BEA SARPP all-items regional price parities, 2008-2024

apps.title: Taxpayer Migration
apps.q: IRS state-to-state and county-to-county taxpayer flows.
apps.heritage: Formerly Taxpayer Migration, State to State Tax Migration, and County to County Migration
apps.scope: This ledger ranks states on IRS SOI net domestic taxpayer migration for tax years 2022-23 (Total Migration-US inflow minus outflow, returns), and also reports the same net for Massachusetts counties.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover Census domestic migration (that is Population and Migration) or advice about relocating for tax reasons.

sources.name: IRS SOI state-to-state migration, tax years 2022-23
IRS SOI county-to-county migration, tax years 2022-23, Massachusetts

apps.title: Tax Statistics
apps.q: Income-tax statistics by state, county, and municipality, plus AGI percentiles.
apps.heritage: Formerly Individual Statistics, Tax Statistics County and Municipalities, and Tracking Wealth
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks states on IRS SOI adjusted gross income for tax year 2022 (all returns). County, municipal, and AGI-percentile tables are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover the wealth-tax and surtax atlas (that is DL-01) or advice about a filing. County and municipal files are pending.

sources.name: IRS SOI historic table 2, tax year 2022 (22in55cmcsv.csv)

apps.title: Transit Systems
apps.q: Compare U.S. transit agencies on ridership, cost, and recovery. Not the MBTA-only page.
apps.heritage: Formerly Compare Systems and MassTransit Comparing Systems
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks U.S. transit agencies on FTA NTD unlinked passenger trips for the latest published month, including every Massachusetts reporter. Operating cost and farebox recovery remain later views. Mode-by-mode MBTA reliability stays on DL-03.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover MBTA mode-by-mode reliability or The RIDE (those stay on DL-03), capital budgets, or fare advice. Agency operating cost and farebox recovery are pending.

sources.name: FTA NTD complete monthly ridership by agency

apps.title: Roads and Risk
apps.q: Roadway travel, FEMA obligations, the National Risk Index, and heating and cooling days.
apps.heritage: Formerly Roadway Transport, FEMA Obligations, National Risk Index, and Heat/Cool Days
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks states on FHWA Highway Statistics 2024 annual vehicle-miles of travel (table VM-2, all functional systems). FEMA obligations, the National Risk Index, and degree days are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover transit agencies (those sit on Transit Systems or DL-03) or Florida insurance (DL-02). FEMA and NOAA files are pending.

sources.name: FHWA Highway Statistics 2024 table VM-2
FEMA OpenFEMA and National Risk Index

apps.title: Energy Supply
apps.q: Energy consumption, production, and CO2 emissions by state. Not the retail-price page.
apps.heritage: Formerly Energy Consumption, Energy Production, and CO2 Emissions
apps.scope: This ledger ranks states on EIA energy-related carbon dioxide emissions for 2022, and also reports EIA SEDS total energy consumption for 2024. SEDS production remains a later view. Retail electricity prices stay on DL-04.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover retail electricity prices (DL-04), energy storage, or advice about a utility bill. SEDS production is pending.

sources.name: EIA state energy-related CO2 emissions, table 1
EIA SEDS total energy consumption (TETCB)

apps.title: Municipal Atlas
apps.q: Choose a Massachusetts city or town, see its snapshot, and find peers.
apps.heritage: Formerly Choose a City or Town, Economic Snapshot, and Find Peers
apps.scope: This first ledger lists all 351 Massachusetts cities and towns by July 1, 2025 Census population (SUMLEV 061). Tax levy and peer sets are listed as later views. Rankings of change sit on Municipal Rankings.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover Boston-only payroll (that is Boston), statewide multi-metric rankings (Municipal Rankings), or advice about moving. DLS levy files are pending.

sources.name: Census vintage 2025 subcounty population estimates, Massachusetts

apps.title: Municipal Rankings
apps.q: Rank Massachusetts cities and towns on crime, debt, education, spending, revenues, and taxes.
apps.heritage: Formerly the Cities and Towns Rankings suite
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks Massachusetts cities and towns on 2020-to-2025 Census population change. Crime, debt, education, spending, revenue, and tax rankings are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover the per-town atlas stock (Municipal Atlas), Boston payroll, or advice about a town meeting warrant. DLS, DESE, and crime rankings are pending.

sources.name: Census vintage 2025 subcounty population estimates, Massachusetts

apps.title: Boston
apps.q: Boston city budget, payroll, and the former Boston Data Labs views.
apps.heritage: Formerly Boston Data Labs
apps.scope: This ledger ranks City of Boston departments on calendar year 2025 earnings (TOTAL GROSS), and also reports the FY26 adopted operating appropriation by department.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover other municipalities (Municipal Atlas) or statewide payroll (Payroll and Vendors).

sources.name: City of Boston employee earnings report 2025
City of Boston operating budget, FY26 appropriation

apps.title: Massachusetts State Finances
apps.q: Commonwealth tax collections, total revenue, spending, and tax credits.
apps.heritage: Formerly Revenue Tax, Revenue Total, Spending Total, and Tax Credits
apps.scope: This first ledger reports Massachusetts state tax collections by type for 2026 Q1 from the Census Quarterly Summary of State and Local Tax Revenue. DOR monthly collections, total spending, and tax credits are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover municipal levies (Municipal Rankings), the 51-state ranking (U.S. State Finances), or advice about a filing. DOR monthly and tax-credit files are pending.

sources.name: Census QTAX 2026 Q1 table 3, state tax collections by type

apps.title: U.S. State Finances
apps.q: State and local revenues, expenses, rainy-day funds, and public-employee counts.
apps.heritage: Formerly the State Finance overview, State Employees, Government Organizations, Party Dominance, Financial Transparency, and US Public Pensions
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks states on Census QTAX 2026 Q1 total state tax collections. The Annual Survey of State Government Finances, NASBO rainy-day funds, and public-employee counts are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover Massachusetts retirement boards (DL-05), the Massachusetts type-of-tax split (Massachusetts State Finances), or party-registration advice. Annual finance and rainy-day files are pending.

sources.name: Census QTAX 2026 Q1 table 3, total state taxes
NASBO Fiscal Survey of the States, rainy-day funds

apps.title: Payroll and Vendors
apps.q: Massachusetts state, higher-ed, and quasi-public payroll, plus vendor payments.
apps.heritage: Formerly Payroll State Agencies, Higher Education, Quasi Public Agencies, and Vendor Payments
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks Commonwealth departments on CTHRU calendar-2025 payroll (pay_total_actual), and reports Comptroller-recorded spending for fiscal 2025. Quasi-public payroll detail and a vendor-only extract remain later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover municipal payroll (Boston or Municipal Atlas), retiree pensions (DL-05), named-employee lookups, or advice about a contract bid. Quasi-public payroll detail is pending.

sources.name: CTHRU Commonwealth of Massachusetts payroll v4
CTHRU Comptroller of the Commonwealth spending

apps.title: Crime and Justice
apps.q: Crime rates, adult and juvenile incarceration, and internet crime.
apps.heritage: Formerly Crime Rates, Adult Incarceration, Juvenile Incarceration, and Internet Crime
apps.scope: This first ledger ranks states on BJS prisoners under jurisdiction at year-end 2023. FBI crime rates, juvenile incarceration, and IC3 internet-crime reports are listed as later views.
apps.exclusions: Does not cover Massachusetts municipal crime rankings (Municipal Rankings) or advice about a case. FBI, juvenile, and IC3 files are pending.

sources.name: FBI Crime Data Explorer / UCR and NIBRS
BJS Prisoners in 2023 statistical tables, table 2
